  1. Description

Interface TomlValue

All Known Implementing Classes:
TomlArray, TomlBoolean, TomlFloat, TomlInteger, TomlLocalDate, TomlLocalDateTime, TomlLocalTime, TomlOffsetDateTime, TomlString, TomlTable
public sealed interface TomlValue permits TomlTable, TomlArray, TomlString, TomlInteger, TomlFloat, TomlBoolean, TomlOffsetDateTime, TomlLocalDateTime, TomlLocalDate, TomlLocalTime
A TOML value: a table, an array, or a scalar.

Values are immutable, and each one can be written as TOML: the constructors reject what TOML cannot represent, such as a date outside the years 0000 to 9999.

The hierarchy is sealed, so a switch over a value can cover every type: 

String describe(TomlValue value) {
    return switch (value) {
        case TomlString(var s) -> "the string " + s;
        case TomlInteger(var i) -> "the integer " + i;
        case TomlTable table -> "a table of " + table.entries().size() + " entries";
        default -> "something else";
    };
}
